column1: # Stage S2 — crate births. Paths name the tree before the moves (after s2_apps_and_deploy.tsv).
# http_url_guard: the API's copy of the predicate and its tests become the crate's module
# offline_cache_policy: the worker library's policy modules and tests
# (the worker's src/README.md is no row: the folder keeps a README of its own, so the path is never retired)
# the worker binary becomes the package root; range slicing stays with it
# the policy paths move module by module: a one-segment crate prefix would also rewrite the bare
# package and bundle name `offline_service_worker`, which the worker keeps
